title: flimsy
text: flimsy. These tongs are flimsy. I got them through a great Prime Day deal but I'd prefer to spend more for a sturdier product. I sent mine back to Amazon.

product_metadata.title: Silicone Kitchen Tongs for Cooking with Silicone Tips, Heat Resistant Tongs for Serving Food, 7-Inch, 9-Inch, 12-Inch Locking Silicone Tongs, Set of 3 Salad Tongs, Aqua Sky Kitchen Utensils
features: Handy Set of Tongs — Turn and flip food easily with Culinary Couture’s non stick safe tongs. This silicon tongs kitchen utensils set comes with three tongs in three different sizes so you can choose the appropriate size for the food you are preparing or serving.

Made of Premium Materials — Rest easy knowing that these tongs will be your long-time kitchen companion. Made of stainless steel and great-quality silicone heads, these easy to clean cooking tongs can withstand heat up to 480°F. They are suitable for serving any type of food.

Safe for You and Your Cookware — Our stain- and odor-resistant rubber tipped tongs tongs with silicone tips are ideal for nonstick cookware. These food-safe kitchen must-haves contain zero BPAs so your food will never get contaminated, no matter how often you use them.

Easy to Use and Store — Our kitchen tongs have a non-slip ring pull locking mechanism that allows the tongs to remain either closed or open. The ring also doubles as a loop — excellent for hanging and easy storage.

Excellent Gift for Culinary Enthusiasts — This set of silicone-tipped tongs is a great gift for anyone who enjoys cooking. The silicone tongs for air fryer come in a beautifully designed gift box, making it an ideal and elegant present for any occasion.
